scope: F03 diagnostic of F02 half-exit benefits versus lost recoveries; zero new economic strategies
cohort: Every F02 primary baseline_observed +60m checkpoint, four separately reported windows/models; selected actual MFI-half fills matched by episode entry. No future-label-based selection. Ineligible/censored cases retained separately.
label: Actual archived MFI-half completed episode net minus its unchanged baseline episode net, including all fees/partials. Positive = helpful cut; negative = harmful cut, even if baseline eventually loses. Non-selected controls have no hypothetical cut label.

contrasts.name: 30m downside volume shock

timing: Primary closed indicators publication0; legacy HL buckets+60s. Sensitivity adds60s to closed indicators and legacy HL bucket lag; exact price/SR queries shifted60s as a whole. Recorded sample times remain availability proxies unless receive metadata exists. Missing/conflicting/stale data is unknown, never false. SR engine rebuilt on exact30m boundaries before query; only closed5m constituents.
report: Baseline and original MFI-half W/L, win dollars/loss dollars, net/DD and monthly MTM adjacent. Twelve fixed contrasts: flagged/unflagged/unknown benefit and harm dollars, counts, month and delay. All validated indicator families retained with -4h/-1h/-15m/now paths and source references. Never pool overlapping periods/models; no holdout claim. Subset contribution is attribution, NOT a new filtered replay net or drawdown. No threshold optimization, no additional combinations, no promotion without separately frozen changed-path replay and forward observation.
